title: Diagnostic accuracy of circulating microRNAs in Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease: data, code and results
description: Search exports, extraction tables with the verbatim source sentence for every value, audit log, analysis and figure scripts, and result tables for a systematic review and meta-analysis of circulating microRNAs as diagnostic biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease. Registered retrospectively on OSF (10.17605/OSF.IO/NJ8A5). From version 1.2.0 the archive also holds the parameter table of measured kinetic constants (each tied to its source sentence), the differential-equation models of the miR-29/BACE1/Aβ42 and miR-7/α-synuclein axes, the dosing analysis of microRNA mimics and the figures of that mechanistic study.

creators.name: Capucho, Wesley Felipe

notes: Scripts are under the MIT licence (LICENSE); data, tables, figures and documentation under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA.md). Third-party material (two supplementary tables of published papers; titles and abstracts of the screened records) keeps its own terms. The Scopus and Web of Science export files are not distributed; exports_manifest.csv records their record counts and SHA-256 hashes. CHANGELOG.md lists what changed between versions.
